copy.absolute_only: Only absolute (unconditional) convergence is estimated. Conditional convergence needs controls (investment, schooling, institutions) that this atlas does not include.
copy.interpretation: Tercile fits split on initial income (the regressor), not on current income or current World Bank income group, to avoid selecting on the outcome; they have fewer observations and wide intervals.
copy.not_causal: A negative slope means poorer countries grew faster on average in this window. It does not show that initial income causes faster growth, or that any single country will catch up.

method: Absolute beta-convergence: regress 100*(ln y_end - ln y_start)/T (percent per year) on ln y_start across countries with both endpoints; HC3 standard errors, t(n-2) 95% CI, plus a seeded case-bootstrap percentile CI (2000 draws). Samples: primary (excludes countries with a territory break in the window), sensitivity_all (includes them), initial-income terciles, and a population-weighted fit (initial population). Sigma: population SD of ln income across countries. PPP and constant-USD are estimated separately and never pooled.
